title: Tilt-shift and contact shadows
description: The depth look of src/post.ts (docs/graphics.md): each view frozen in time and shot three ways, without either effect, with contact shadows (orthographic SSAO) only, and with the tilt-shift depth of field too. The street following Gerard and from above (R), the Meridiana flat, the house's first floor, La Reina Bubbaloo's palace and a fight, plus debug views of the fight's blur and contact shadows.

steps.eval: window.look = (tilt, ssao, debug) => { const g = window.gerard.game, p = g.post; p.tiltShift = tilt; p.ssao = ssao; p.frame.debug = debug ?? null; p.frame.update(); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) g.app.fire('update', 0); };
